Name: Cometkin's Style of Baubles Wool and Cloth
Author: Necolle
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Cometkin's base game wool and cloth sprites were recolored to fit Baubles' additional wools and cloths to be more visually seamless. This is a REPLACER.

[size=4][b]How to install:[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]1. Download this mod and Baubles[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]2. Extract both to your folder.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]3. Move [CP] Baubles into your Baubles folder.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]3. Replace the file when prompted to.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]4. Enjoy![/color]

Thank you ^^![/color]
